Class AbandonedShip

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.cards.Card
it.polimi.ingsw.model.cards.AbandonedShip
All Implemented Interfaces:
CardInterface, Serializable
public class AbandonedShip extends Card implements Serializable
Class that manages the single card abandoned ship In order of position, starting from the leader, the trucker decides, checking the crew members requirement, if he/she wants to lose members of the crew and days of flight in exchange for cosmic credits. Only one trucker car take the station and is possible that nobody wants to take it
